summary: Deletes the single agentic-upgrade guide that the upgrade CLI previously copied and handed to the agent. Its content is split into shared, different-major, same-major and future-defaults guides added elsewhere in this PR. The text is draft agent instructions, so a skim of the split content is enough; the CLI wiring is reviewed in its own unit.
headline: Remove monolithic agentic-upgrade guide, replaced by split guides
reason: Draft documentation deletion whose content is moved into new split guides; runtime wiring changes are in next-upgrade.ts, not here.
